title: The Keeper's Trust
description: Severin Vane keeps to an order that watches what kingdoms will not admit to. Willow Dale was theirs once, a watchpost, and something has woken in the ruin of it. Break the rite and bring him proof.

objectives.description: Travel to the Willow Dale ruins northwest of Dalhurst
Investigate the source of the dark energy
Defeat the cultists performing the ritual (0/5)
Return to Severin Vane with evidence of what you found

notes: Threat given a clock (days, not weeks) and a named consequence (reaches the farms outside Dalhurst) per audit's 'no consequence for refusing'. Consistent with aldric_vane_keepers.json's own line about villages disappearing and dead zones. Unwired - no in-game timer enforces the days/weeks claim; recorded for a later pass.
